summary: University of Algarve is listed as QS 2026 rank 1001-1200. University of Algarve has 2 source-backed AI policy claim records from 2 official source attributions. The public record preserves original-language evidence snippets, source URLs, snapshot hashes, confidence, and review state.

newClaim.claimText: An official University of Algarve 2024-25 Market Studies course sheet states that, for that course, fraud, plagiarism, or improper use of Artificial Intelligence is handled under paragraph 15 of UAlg's Assessment Regulations, and the instructor may require an additional test if there is doubt. This is course-level assessment-integrity evidence, not a general AI policy for all UAlg courses.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Em caso de fraude, plágio ou uso indevido de Inteligência Artificial aplica-se o disposto no n.º 15 do Regulamento de Avaliação da UALG. Em situação de dúvida, o docente poderá exigir uma prova adicional que substituirá o elemento de avaliação em causa.

newClaim.claimText: University of Algarve's official pedagogical-innovation page identifies a working group that supports AI-related digital pedagogy and prepares guiding documents for the use of AI and other digital tools in UAlg academic contexts. This is source-status evidence of an AI guidance workstream, not a published binding university-wide AI policy.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: O Grupo de trabalho em Inovação Pedagógica e Novas Tecnologias foi criado com intuito de: ... Apoiar o desenvolvimento do conhecimento científico e tecnológico sobre ferramentas digitais, designadamente Inteligência Artificial (IA) ... e elaborar documentos orientadores para utilização da IA e outras ferramentas digitais em contexto académico na UAlg.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: The working group supports knowledge about AI and other digital tools for higher-education teaching and is tasked with preparing guidance documents for using AI and other digital tools in UAlg academic contexts.
